Fig. 2 — Vision shopper

How a vision shopper decides

Every decision is made by a vision-language model looking at what the shopper would see — a rendered shelf or a real photo of it. The model only rates; purchases are seeded draws, so two layouts are compared on the very same people.

At the door

store directory map + today

Reads the situation and where it came from; writes its mission, then decides whether to enter and what to buy.

EntryDecision { mission, enter, items: [{category, product, qty}] }

Judge

the VLM rates, never buys

Names the most eye-catching product by its tag and how tempting it is, given persona, basket and plan.

ShelfGlance { product, number, interest: 0–10, reason }
